- Saved the digest's starting point in `/workspace/digests/coastal-team-digest-state.json`. It's set to start from now, so tomorrow's first digest will cover everything posted from today onward.

Once the scheduler works, I'll set the job up for 09:00 America/Chicago starting 15 October and check that a test run lands in this DM. Until then, I can post a digest of #coastal-team here on request.
